games.title: Make That Sound
games.description:
Make That Sound! is a fast, silly party game for 1 to many players. Each round, a mystery sound plays: a ringtone, a siren, a cuckoo clock, a rocket launch. Then it’s your turn to copy it with your voice.

Everyone performs at once. Your character steps up to the mic on a real stage and moves with your voice.
Hear everyone’s attempt. After recording, each player’s clip plays back one at a time, with their character on the mic.
Scored on the match. You get up to 100 points for matching the sound’s rhythm and pitch, then friends vote for who nailed it, worth 20 bonus points per vote.
Different every round. The same sound comes back higher, lower, faster, slower or reversed, so no two rounds play the same.
Play your way. Take on 1 to 3 AI opponents on Easy, Medium or Hard, or host a party and invite friends with a 5-letter code.
Make it yours. Pick your avatar, the number of rounds, light or dark theme, and open mic or hold to talk.

games.title: Quoridor
games.description:
Quoridor is the classic strategy board game of racing and blocking. Move your pawn across the board to the opposite edge, or spend a wall to throw your opponent off course. Every move is a choice, and you can never completely trap anyone.

Features:

Play the computer on Easy, Medium or Hard, from relaxed games to a tough opponent that plans several moves ahead
Play online by sharing a room code with a friend, with no account needed
Pass and play with two players on one screen
Smart wall placement with a live preview, and illegal walls are blocked for you
Polished look with smooth animations, sound effects, an animated intro and a victory screen
Quick to learn: a short how-to-play guide is built in

games.title: Realm of Mortals
games.description:
Become a god in Realm of Mortals, a living voxel world where tribes found villages, farm the land, build castles and march to war. You have unlimited divine power and 18 ways to use it. Heal and bless your people, summon rain and forests, raise mountains, or unleash tornadoes, plagues, earthquakes, volcanoes and meteor storms.

Shape civilizations

Tribes grow from Tribal to Medieval, building houses, farms, windmills, markets, blacksmiths, cathedrals, watchtowers, barracks, stables and castles.
Place units and buildings yourself, or drop in a prebuilt civilization, from a humble hamlet to a grand empire.
Command villagers, warriors, archers, knights, horse swordsmen and healing priests.

Rule the diplomacy

Declare war, sign peace, forge trade pacts or alliances. Allies join your wars, and betrayal has consequences.

A world that feels alive

Day and night, four seasons, weather, spreading fires, and music that turns darker when war breaks out.
10 save slots let you keep several worlds going.

games.title: Moo Who
games.description:
Moo Who? is a multiplayer game of hide-and-seek and bluffing on a sunset farm. Each round, one random player becomes the seeker and the other three become hiders.

Hiders pick an animal (cow, pig, goat, dog, sheep or chicken). No two hiders can pick the same one. Each hider then records two voices with their own microphone. The first is a herd voice, which every NPC animal of the same kind will use. The second is their own voice, which plays when they call. Once the hunt starts, hiders have to keep making sound, or their voice plays automatically. They can copy the herd voice to blend in, or make it different to bluff the seeker.

The seeker waits blindfolded through the prep and a 15-second head start, then searches the farm. The shotgun has limited shells, and shooting an NPC wastes one. The game shows ❌ WRONG or ✅ CORRECT after every shot. Hiders win by surviving 3 minutes, and the seeker wins by finding all three.

The party host can choose whether NPC animals make sounds along with the players, or only player voices are heard. The host can also decide whether the farm has all animals or only the animals the hiders picked.

games.title: Golden Duck Hunt
games.description:
Deep in the hay of Quackwood Farm lies a legend: a Golden Rubber Duck buried among thousands of ordinary ones. Grab your radar, listen for the beeps, and start digging.

First-person digging: Walk the haystack, follow your radar’s beeps as ducks get closer, and dig them out.
Four difficulties: Easy has 150 ducks, Normal 600, Hard 1,500 and Insane 4,000. The haystack grows with each level.
Shops: Sell your ducks to the Duck Buyer, since rarer yellow, pink, blue and rainbow ducks are worth more. Spend the coins at the Tool Shop on better shovels, radars and boots. The Golden Sensor radar gives a special ping when the golden duck is near.
Multiplayer: Host a party and share the 5-letter code. Everyone digs the same haystack, sees each other and each other’s holes, and the first to find the golden duck wins.
Saving: There are 10 save slots plus an autosave. If you get disconnected, you can rejoin your party with your coins, ducks and tools intact.
Cutscenes: There’s a story intro, scenes at each shop and the haystack, and a golden finale when you find the duck.

games.title: Aurelia: Tides of the Sleeping Dragon
games.description:
A land where the tides remember, the mountains sing, and an old sleeping power is beginning to stir.

Aurelia is an original monster-catching adventure that plays in your browser. You walk a 2D overworld, battle in animated turn-based fights, and build a team from 55 monsters. Your journey runs from a quiet harbor town to the League at Aurelion Peak. Along the way you uncover the legend of Aurelion, the Tide Dragon, and a secret that ties your own mentor to the villains.

The adventure
Region: 12 cities, from Driftwood Cove, Brinehaven, Mossgrove, Cinderpost, Voltspire and Hollowmere to Stonecrest, Duskwater, Frostmere, Wyrmrest, Gilded Harbor and Aurelion Peak.
8 Gyms and 8 badges:Gym Leader	Town	Type
Marla Tide	Brinehaven	Water
Fennel Arbor	Mossgrove	Grass
Kael Ashgrove	Cinderpost	Fire
Juno Voltaire	Voltspire	Electric
Garnet Stonehand	Stonecrest	Rock
Morwen Hollow	Duskwater	Ghost
Sable Frostwick	Frostmere	Ice
Drasa Wyrmward	Wyrmrest	Dragon
The League: four Elite members, Ione (Ice), Corvin (Dark), Tamsin (Fire) and Halcyon (Water/Dragon). Champion Solenne waits at the top.
Story: your rival Vesper and her missing brother Cal, the sinister Team Undertow (Captain Mordecai Vale, Lt. Nyx, Admin Brine), and your mentor Professor Thorne. The Undertow are hunting the pearls that can wake Aurelion, and there are several plot twists along the way.
Game features
Character creation: a Trainer License with a live preview. You choose appearance, height, birthday, blood type and a “dream” that gives a starting perk.
Cinematic opening: an animated title screen, a legend prologue, a lab scene for choosing your starter, and a sunrise intro.
Three game worlds: separate save slots, each its own adventure, with auto-save.
2D overworld: walk with arrow keys or WASD, or an on-screen pad. Tall grass triggers wild encounters, and the map darkens in the evening based on your device’s clock.
Animated battles: attack animations, damage numbers, super-effective and critical hits, burn, paralysis and sleep, and EXP gain. In trainer fights you see the opponent’s character and a row showing how many monsters they have left.
Catching: Catch Orb, Great Orb, Ultra Orb and Master Orb. Odds depend on the monster’s HP, status, rarity and the orb.
Towns: a Monster Center to heal your team, an Orb Mart (orbs, Potions, Revives and EXP Candies), NPCs, and cutscenes with evolution animations.
Quests and tournaments: 12 side quests, 3 new daily quests each day with streak bonuses, and the Bronze, Silver, Gold and Champion Cups.
Sound: music and sound effects, with a mute button.
Post-game: the Battle Tower, hard Gym rematches, a World Ranking, and rare legendary hunts at Aurelion Peak.
Types and abilities

There are 10 types: Normal, Fire, Water, Grass, Electric, Ice, Rock, Ghost, Dark and Dragon.

A monster’s ability depends on its first type:

Overgrow (Grass first), Blaze (Fire first) and Torrent (Water first). Below ⅓ HP, these boost damage from moves of that same type by 50%.
Keen Eye is the ability for every other first type.

games.title: Plotline
games.description:
Plotline is a multiplayer property tycoon played on a map of the whole world. Pick a spot, from the Florida coast to the streets of Tokyo, and buy plots of land. Build farms, shops, factories, solar farms, apartments and hotels. Add floors, set rents, keep your tenants warm, and watch your cash grow while you play.

Play with friends. Create a world, share its five-letter code, and everyone builds on the same map.
Make offers. Want your friend’s best plot? Name your price, and they can accept or decline.
Climate matters. Cold places cost more to heat, farms suffer in frost, and solar farms shine near the equator.
Climb the leaderboard. See who’s richest and who owns the most plots.
Your worlds are saved. Come back any time and pick up where you left off, even while you’re away your buildings keep earning.
No friends online? Play offline against computer-run rivals who compete with you for land.

games.title: Ultimate Party
games.description:
The five rounds

🧠 Trivia: a multiple-choice question where faster correct answers score more.
🎨 Drawing: everyone draws the same prompt on a touch canvas, then everyone votes. You get 100 points per vote.
🤥 Bluff: everyone writes a fake answer to an obscure-fact question. You get 200 points for spotting the real answer and 100 for each person you fool.
⌨️ Speed typing: type the sentence exactly. Finishers are ranked by time, and anyone who doesn’t finish gets partial credit.
😂 Meme: an emoji and a situation appear, everyone writes a caption, and everyone votes. You get 100 points per vote.

games.title: Kingdom Tower Defense
games.description:
Kingdom Defense is a tower defense game where you protect your castle from waves of goblins, wolves, orcs, knights, and dragons.

Campaign

5 chapters with 8 worlds each: Meadow Kingdom, Dusty Dunes, Frostpeak, Ember Crags, and Void Citadel.
Every world is harder than the last, with new map layouts and scenery in each chapter.
Each world ends in a boss fight, and world 8 of every chapter has two bosses. If a boss reaches your castle, the run is lost.

Units

Start with one basic Archer and earn coins and XP from every world you play.
Spend coins in the shop on 8 units: Archer, Cannon, Treasury, Mage, Ballista, Fire Mage, Tesla Coil, and Dragon Roost.
Many units need a minimum player level before you can buy them.
Upgrade each tower up to level 3 in battle, or sell it for most of its cost back.

Loadout

Bring only a limited set of units into battle: 3 slots at level 1, a 4th slot at level 6, and a 5th at level 12.
Choose your loadout to fit each chapter.

Upgrades

Buy permanent upgrades that boost damage, starting gold, and castle health.

Co-op

Create a party and share the 5-letter code with your friends.
Defend together with shared gold and a shared castle, while everyone keeps their own coins and XP.

Other features

Choose how each tower targets enemies: first, strongest, or last.
Speed up battles to 2x or 3x, or turn on auto-start for waves.
Castle health bar, enemy health bars you can hide, and floating damage numbers.
Your progress saves automatically.

games.title: Clipwise
games.description:
Clipwise gives you a timeline editor with the speed of AI.

Edit

Merge as many clips as you like into one video, reorder them, split, trim and change speed, zoom and volume.
Auto Cut scores your footage by voices, sound hits, motion and sharpness, then cuts to the best parts. Choose Smart, Talking, ASMR Impact, Beat montage or AI Director. Set the pace and target length, and undo anytime.

Captions and text

20 animated caption styles with word-by-word highlighting, plus font, colour, outline, shadow and box controls. Drag captions into place on the preview.
Auto-generate captions where your browser’s speech recognition supports it, or import .srt/.vtt files, paste a script, or type along with a built-in caption desk. Translate captions into other languages with Claude.
Add text layers as bars on the timeline. Move and trim them, and give each its own animation.

Effects and looks

Fades, flashes, zooms, glitch, VHS, shake and more, as bars you can move and trim on the timeline.
Filters, vignette, film grain, voice enhancement and generated background music.

AI tools (use Claude)

AI-designed thumbnails built from the best moments in your video.
Titles, descriptions, tags and hashtags written from your video’s content.
AI Studio turns a prompt or script into a lavender-paper motion-graphics video with cards, bold type and a marker call to action.

Export

Vertical, square, 4:5, 16:9 and more, with 720p, 1080p, 1440p or 4K, at 24, 30 or 60 fps.

games.title: World Tycoon
games.description: World Tycoon is a business management and economic strategy game where players buy plots of land, build thriving businesses, and expand their commercial empire. Start with limited funds, purchase affordable properties, and choose from a variety of businesses including Coffee Shops, Grocery Stores, Restaurants, Factories, Hotels, and Tech Offices. Earn passive income, upgrade your businesses, franchise successful locations, and strategically reinvest profits to dominate the market. With save management, multiplayer support, and deep economic progression, every decision shapes the growth of your global business empire.
